svg.text: DocuProcess Cloud — Arquitectura de Referencia en AWS
Ambiente: AWS Academy Sandbox (Vocareum) | Topología: CloudFront Proxy + ALB + ASG EC2 (non-root) + RDS Cifrado + S3 Presigned + DynamoDB + SNS + Resource Policies

g.text: Amazon VPC (10.0.0.0/16) — Subredes Públicas & Privadas Multi-AZ
Sin SSH :22 — acceso por SSM Agent
t3.micro | Min: 2 / Max: 4 | EBS gp2 20GB | Target Group ALB :80
• Worker: S3 get_object real + FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
• Resource Policies (S3 / DDB / SNS) + Estado FAILED
Port 22 SSH: BLOCKED | SSM Session Mgr: READY
• Worker: S3 get_object real + FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
• Resource Policies (S3 / DDB / SNS) + Estado FAILED
Port 22 SSH: BLOCKED | SSM Session Mgr: READY
• Bloqueo atómico: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
• SG estricto: solo ingress TCP 3306 desde ASG
Navegador → CloudFront → (OAC S3 Frontend | Reverse Proxy /api/* & /health → ALB :80 → ASG EC2)
Navegador → S3 Docs (Presigned PUT s3v4) | Worker EC2 (docuprocess) → S3 get_object real + SHA-256
EC2 ↔ RDS Cifrado (SKIP LOCKED) | EC2 → DynamoDB / SNS (Resource Policies) | CloudWatch → ASG (≥75% +1 / ≤25% -1) & SNS
